items.sectionInstructionKo: [17] 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
The people (A) ______ over there (B) ______ my friends.
① stood — is
② standing — is
③ standing — are
④ stood — are
⑤ to stand — are

items.sectionInstructionKo: [18–19] 다음 문장을 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn:
나는 그 소식에 어떻게 반응해야 할지 몰랐다.
I didn't know how I should respond to the news.
= I didn't know ______ to the news.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [18–19] 다음 문장을 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn:
우리는 너무 피곤해서 그곳까지 걸어서 도착할 수 없었다.
We were so tired that we couldn't reach there on foot.
= We were ______ there on foot.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [20] 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① Each building have an elevator.
② All of the information were not true.
③ I burned me on the oven by mistake.
④ I need five red roses and two pink roses.
⑤ There aren't some Spanish restaurants near here.
choices: All of the information were not true.
I burned me on the oven by mistake.
I need five red roses and two pink roses.
There aren't some Spanish restaurants near here.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [21] 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① I traveled around the world <u>by myself</u>.
② The director made a movie <u>about himself</u>.
③ You should control <u>yourself</u> and stay calm.
④ We should not compare <u>ourselves</u> with others.
⑤ They made the travel plans <u>themselves</u>.
choices: I traveled around the world <u>by myself</u>.
The director made a movie <u>about himself</u>.
You should control <u>yourself</u> and stay calm.
We should not compare <u>ourselves</u> with others.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [22] 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 서로 다른 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① I ran in order not to miss the bus.
= I ran so as not to miss the bus.
② It is important not to break the rules.
= Not breaking the rules is important.
③ We really like going hiking on weekends.
= We really like to go hiking on weekends.
④ Paul remembered to clean the house.
Paul remembered cleaning the house.
⑤ She is smart enough to teach others.
= She is so smart that she can teach others.
choices:
I ran in order not to miss the bus.
= I ran so as not to miss the bus.

It is important not to break the rules.
= Not breaking the rules is important.

We really like going hiking on weekends.
= We really like to go hiking on weekends.

Paul remembered to clean the house.
Paul remembered cleaning the house.

She is smart enough to teach others.
= She is so smart that she can teach others.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [23–24] 우리말과 일치하도록 문장을 쓰세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn: 그는 비밀번호를 바꾼 것을 잊어버렸다.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [23–24] 우리말과 일치하도록 문장을 쓰세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn: 나는 따뜻한 차를 만들기 위해 물을 끓였다.
accept: I boiled water in order to make warm tea.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [25] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 대화를 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① A: Hello. May I come in?
B: Of course. Make yourself comfortable, Minho.
② A: Ryan, what is your brother doing?
B: He is busy feeding the cats at home.
③ A: Are you interested in going to the music festival?
B: Of course. I spend my free time listening to music.
④ A: Will you come to my party tomorrow?
B: Sure. Let me know how to bring.
⑤ A: I'm too tired to walk anymore. I need a rest.
B: Come here. There are benches to sit on.
choices:
A: Hello. May I come in?
B: Of course. Make yourself comfortable, Minho.

A: Ryan, what is your brother doing?
B: He is busy feeding the cats at home.

A: Are you interested in going to the music festival?
B: Of course. I spend my free time listening to music.

A: Will you come to my party tomorrow?
B: Sure. Let me know how to bring.

A: I'm too tired to walk anymore. I need a rest.
B: Come here. There are benches to sit on.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [26] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
ⓐ We are glad to see you again.
ⓑ The baked potatoes tasted good.
ⓒ I have trouble to memorize numbers.
ⓓ The coffee was so hot to drink right away.
ⓔ The teacher needs a computer to use in class.
① ⓐ, ⓑ
② ⓑ, ⓒ
③ ⓒ, ⓓ
④ ⓓ, ⓔ
⑤ ⓐ, ⓔ

items.sectionInstructionKo: [27–28] 다음 대화에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분 두 군데를 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요. 어법에 맞지 않은 부분을 고친 말만 쓰세요.
items.promptEn:
틀린 두 곳을 위에서부터 고친 말만 쓰세요.
A: I can't decide what to eat for dinner. Do you have any menu in mind?
B: There are several choices. One is pizza, another is pasta, and the other is Chinese food or sushi. What do you want?
A: Both pizza and pasta sounds good. How about ordering both?
B: Yes. Let's share them.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [27–28] 다음 대화에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분 두 군데를 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요. 어법에 맞지 않은 부분을 고친 말만 쓰세요.
items.promptEn:
틀린 두 곳을 위에서부터 고친 말만 쓰세요.
A: Have you been to the new art museum that was built last month?
B: Yes. I went there last Saturday. I was surprising at the huge space. It was big enough to display many paintings.
A: I want to see some great artwork there, too. How much is a ticket?
B: It is 10,000 won per person. You can get a discount by show your student ID.
